CubeInterfaceConfig.sql: SELECT a.[id] AS [id],a.[interfaceName] AS [interfaceName],a.[modeid] AS [modeid],a.[addtype] AS [addtype],a.[updatetype] AS [updatetype],a.[remark] AS [remark],a.[batchMaxCount] AS [batchMaxCount],a.[batchMaxSize] AS [batchMaxSize],a.[createUserType] AS [createUserType],a.[doCardInterface] AS [doCardInterface],a.[encryptionMode] AS [encryptionMode],a.[encryptionPath] AS [encryptionPath],a.[interfacetype] AS [interfacetype],a.[conditiontype] AS [conditiontype],a.[conditiontext] AS [conditiontext],a.[ischeckRight] AS [ischeckRight],a.[isReturnDetailTable] AS [isReturnDetailTable],a.[searchSqlwhere] AS [searchSqlwhere],a.[docardinterface_add] AS [docardinterface_add],a.[docardinterface_update] AS [docardinterface_update] FROM dbo.[CubeInterfaceConfig] a WHERE a.modeid IN ({all_mode_ids})

cubeInterfaceConfigDetail.sql: SELECT a.[id] AS [id],a.[mainid] AS [mainid],a.[fieldid] AS [fieldid],a.[isRequired] AS [isRequired],a.[isPK] AS [isPK],a.[valueType] AS [valueType],a.[tablename] AS [tablename],a.[isreturn] AS [isreturn],a.[returntype] AS [returntype] FROM dbo.[cubeInterfaceConfigDetail] a WHERE a.mainid IN ({cube_interface_ids})
